about: The Capital (Colonnade City) module library, generated by tools/assets/build_capital_modules.py -- do not edit by hand.

av.about: avenue house, arcade rank: arcade + piano nobile + attic + entablature + balustrade

avp.about: avenue house projecting centre (every 5th house, set 0.6 m forward): as av, pediment instead of balustrade

wd.about: ward street: rusticated ground + piano nobile + entablature + balustrade

yd3.about: courtyard face of an avenue house (placed at z = -14, turned): 3 plain storeys + entablature, eaves behind

yd2.about: courtyard face of a ward house: 2 plain storeys + entablature

sd3.about: side-street face of a corner house: avenue height without the arcade

curtain.source: zones/capital_walls.ts CL_WALL.walk = 15 (decisions 13: the curtain raised over the houses); the outer parapet coping at 16.2

lodDistances.note: metres from camera to the culling cell; per-cell LOD, the cells are CITY-LOADING.md CellIndex cells

CL_Stone.about: the one limestone atlas; its night (the returned city LOD2 windows, the lamp cores) is the facade glow sheets

CL_Glass.about: lamplit panes in the returned city facade glow sheet only

backFaceCulling: every material is single-sided (glTF doubleSided false): keep backFaceCulling on; two-sided surfaces carry their own back faces
vertexColor: baked ambient occlusion x per-surface tint; set useVertexColors, hasVertexAlpha = false
uv: glTF convention (origin top-left): load every sheet with invertY = false

tree.note: plant one of the five at random yaw; trees.ts gives each its own LOD and wind

partsAbout: the merged shells' parts (MERGE_ONLY): built into tools/assets/build/capital/, never shipped -- no zone places one on its own
